The '''Constitution of Naboo''' was the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] constitution of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], the Royal House attempted to rewrite it so [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] could stay in office longer. She stepped down, anyway, with all the rights to retire from politics. This information seems to have been common knowledge, as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] mentioned it to Amidala<ref name="Episode II" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
